column2: Painterly digital illustration of a single full-body character for a 2.5D RPG world sprite, matching our card art and NPC portraits (clean bold shapes, soft cel-shaded lighting from the upper left, rich saturated colors). Viewed from a LOW camera, nearly eye-level and slightly above the character (about 25 degrees down). Crisp clean silhouette with no thin wispy bits. Fully transparent background (PNG with alpha). Feet resting on one ground line about 4% from the bottom edge, character centered. No ground shadow, no glow halo, no text. Vertical 2:3, 1024x1536.

A horizontal sprite strip of the SAME character in 4 evenly spaced walk-cycle frames, left to right: WALK1 = left foot forward (contact), WALK2 = passing (legs together, body slightly higher), WALK3 = right foot forward (contact), WALK4 = passing. All 4 frames face the same direction, identical scale, identical outfit and colors, feet on one shared ground line near the bottom, equal spacing with clear empty gaps between frames. Same art style and camera angle as the Sprite Style Lock. Fully transparent background (PNG). No ground shadow, no text. Landscape 3:2, 1536x1024.

Painted distant-scenery backdrop layer for a 3D RPG world, matching our painterly card art. Soft atmospheric perspective: hazier, lighter, and cooler the farther away things are. The scenery sits along the BOTTOM of the image with a clean silhouette; everything above it is fully transparent (PNG with alpha) so the game's sky shows through. Warm golden-hour light from the upper left. No text, no border. Landscape 3:2, 1536x1024. If the row says 'tileable', the left and right edges must match so it repeats seamlessly around the horizon.

A single painterly element (one cloud, a sun glow, or one plant) matching our card art: clean bold shapes, soft cel-shaded lighting from the upper left, warm saturated colors, soft natural edges. Centered, fully transparent background (PNG with alpha), no text, no border. Plants: base at the bottom center as if growing from the ground. Size per row.
Use the Texture Style Lock from the Textures tab (seamless, tileable, hand-painted, flat lighting, 1024x1024).

This tab tracks every asset for the World Look Test: a polished slice of the main town in the chosen style (painted 2.5D sprites, low HD-2D camera with blur and glow, real sky, distant scenery). Directions: FRONT = facing the camera; FRONTSIDE = three-quarter front, facing LEFT; SIDE = profile facing LEFT; BACKSIDE = three-quarter back, facing LEFT; BACK = facing away. The game mirrors left-facing art for right. Relative Height = how tall the character is compared to the player (1.0); the game scales sprites to it. Save to Card Game Art / Pending Review; approved files go to Card Game Art / Approved_WorldTest.
